# Configuration reference (env knobs)

Every knob honors the `MIDMEM_` prefix (legacy `OCMW_` still read as fallback). Parsed from `packages/core/src/config.mjs`; the context column is the source line, so the default is visible verbatim. Canonical deployment pattern: keep all values in ONE shared env file sourced by every wrapper (see INTEGRATION-MODES §5).
